english.title: Owner / master of ship which proceed to sea in contravention of s. 284 direction carrying officer/surveyor
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[master]_

of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY SHIP..), which

(C)_[proceeded to sea in contravention of section 284(2)]_
(D)_[failed to comply with a direction, namely **(..SPECIFY DIRECTION..) given under section 284(1A)(a)]_

of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 and carried away, without

(E)_[his]_
(F)_[her]_

consent,

(G)_[an officer authorised by section 248(1) of the Act to detain the ship,]_
(H)_[a surveyor of ships,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY OFFICER/SURVEYOR..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 284(4) and (5) of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995.

other.penalty:
Summary:: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
